rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Payload {
    meta:
        description = "Detects encrypted Cobalt Strike beacon payload in memory or traffic"
        author = "SOC Team"
        hash = "e86f10ba1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f"
    strings:
        $a = { 69 63 65 69 64 61 74 65 2E 2A 2A 2A 2A 2A 2A 2A 2A 2A 2A 2A 2A 2A 2A 2A 2A 2A 2A 2A 2A } // 'iceidate.' + 24 wild bytes
        $b = { 00 00 00 00 01 00 00 00 [0-255] 01 00 00 00 } // Beacon config markers
    condition:
        uint32(0) == 0x00000400 and ($a at 0 or $b)
}
